calibration_basis.cash_flow_history: 11 governed T0/T1 observations spanning FY2024 through 2026H1; mixed FY/H1/M9/quarter bases must be compared only on compatible periods
calibration_basis.calibration_method: finance-economics ranges plus local historical distribution; every numeric value is an inactive Owner-review candidate, not an approved policy

thresholds.economic_rationale: Economic value requires a return above cost of capital; 2 points is a candidate noise buffer and 5 points approximates a strong spread relative to the 2.02-point historical ROIC volatility.
thresholds.historical_calibration_basis: 21-quarter ROIC range 7.77%-15.47%, median 11.15%, population standard deviation 2.02 points; current governed WACC is unavailable.
thresholds.evidence_requirement: T0/T1 same-basis actual for severe transition; T2 partial estimate supports at most WATCH; T4 anchored sensitivity cannot trigger.
thresholds.persistence_requirement: Candidate: two consecutive comparable quarters for VALUE_DESTRUCTION; one direct period may enter WATCH.
thresholds.recovery_condition: Candidate: two consecutive comparable quarters with governed spread >=2 points and no corroborating value-destruction evidence.
thresholds.hysteresis_rule: TRIGGERED recovery requires two confirmations; WATCH exit requires one confirmation.
thresholds.missing_input_behavior: WACC unavailable -> PENDING_REQUIRED_INPUT; never substitute zero.

thresholds.metric: FCF/CFO persistence with operating-profit, CCC, working-capital, Capex and ROIC corroboration
thresholds.formula: compatible-period FCF and CFO direction plus independent corroborating conditions

candidate_value_or_range.CYCLICAL_OR_TIMING_PRESSURE: one negative period or no corroboration
candidate_value_or_range.STRUCTURAL_DETERIORATION: >=3 negative periods plus >=2 corroborators including CFO weakness

thresholds.economic_rationale: One negative quarter may reflect working-capital or Capex timing; structural deterioration requires persistent failure to convert operating profit into cash.
thresholds.historical_calibration_basis: 11 governed cash-flow observations show sign reversals and mixed cumulative periods, supporting persistence and compatible-period controls rather than a zero threshold.
thresholds.evidence_requirement: T0/T1 compatible-period CFO/FCF plus at least one of CCC, working-capital scale, ROIC or Capex-return evidence.
thresholds.persistence_requirement: Candidate: two quarters for structural risk; three quarters for structural deterioration.
thresholds.recovery_condition: Candidate: two consecutive quarters of positive FCF with CFO repair and no worsening CCC/ROIC corroborator.
thresholds.hysteresis_rule: A structural state cannot be erased by one positive quarter.
thresholds.missing_input_behavior: Incompatible or missing periods -> CANNOT_EVALUATE; never convert missing cash flow to zero.

thresholds.metric: incremental funding need relative to liquidity, net cash and CFO capacity
thresholds.formula: net incremental WC need / each governed same-basis denominator
thresholds.economic_rationale: Funding need becomes decision-relevant only relative to resources available to absorb it; absolute T4 cash needs are not sufficient.
thresholds.historical_calibration_basis: Q2 bridge supports AR, inventory and AP cash impacts, but the governed same-basis net-cash/liquidity denominator is incomplete.
thresholds.evidence_requirement: T1 bridge plus T0/T1 same-basis liquidity, net-cash and CFO-capacity denominators.
thresholds.persistence_requirement: Candidate blocker requires one confirmed denominator breach and corroborating actual liquidity evidence; otherwise WATCH.
thresholds.recovery_condition: All validated ratios below 0.25 and actual liquidity evidence restored for two checkpoints.
thresholds.hysteresis_rule: A confirmed blocker exits only after two denominator-complete validations.
thresholds.missing_input_behavior: Any required denominator unavailable -> PENDING_REQUIRED_INPUT; T4 scenario remains sensitivity only.

thresholds.formula: actual net cash/debt, liquidity, interest burden and actual CFO/FCF evidence; no T4 inputs
thresholds.economic_rationale: Current solvency must be based on actual resources and obligations, not a deliberately adverse scenario.
thresholds.historical_calibration_basis: Current Q2 evidence includes actual cash/net-cash indications but lacks a complete same-basis stress denominator.
thresholds.evidence_requirement: T0/T1 actual balance-sheet and cash-flow evidence.
thresholds.persistence_requirement: WATCH may enter on one direct deterioration; STRESSED requires direct liquidity evidence or two corroborating periods.
thresholds.recovery_condition: Direct liquidity stress removed and actual cash-flow support confirmed for two periods.
thresholds.hysteresis_rule: Stress-scenario changes cannot change this state; STRESSED recovery requires two actual confirmations.
thresholds.missing_input_behavior: Missing actual liquidity evidence -> CANNOT_EVALUATE, never infer from T4.

thresholds.metric: research-stress funding need / governed available liquidity
thresholds.formula: T4 incremental funding need divided by governed same-basis liquidity
thresholds.economic_rationale: Scenario resilience measures absorption capacity but must remain separate from the current balance-sheet state.
thresholds.historical_calibration_basis: Research stress A/B are governed analytical scenarios, not historical outcomes or approved severity definitions.
thresholds.evidence_requirement: T4 scenario plus T0/T1 same-basis liquidity denominator.
thresholds.persistence_requirement: Re-evaluate each formal quarter; cannot alone establish a historical thesis impairment.
thresholds.recovery_condition: Validated ratio returns to <=0.25 with unchanged or better actual liquidity.
thresholds.hysteresis_rule: LOW affects the Add-on candidate only as a soft signal unless actual liquidity corroborates it.

thresholds.formula: (1 + compatible numerator growth) / (1 + compatible share-count growth) - 1
thresholds.economic_rationale: Share issuance creates dilution only when compatible per-share value grows more slowly; exact compounding avoids subtraction approximation error.
thresholds.historical_calibration_basis: EPS/BVPS history is available, but period-end share history is sparse; thresholds are finance-economics candidates pending Owner review.
thresholds.evidence_requirement: Compatible T0/T1 numerator and denominator; T2 supports PARTIAL/WATCH only.
thresholds.persistence_requirement: Candidate COMPOUNDING or DETERIORATING requires two compatible periods.
thresholds.recovery_condition: Spread >=-1 for two compatible periods; structural recovery prefers >=3.
thresholds.hysteresis_rule: One period cannot move directly between COMPOUNDING and DETERIORATING.

thresholds.metric: share growth versus EPS, BVPS and FCF/share compounding
thresholds.formula: count of compatible negative per-share compounding spreads while share count grows

candidate_value_or_range.NO_DILUTION_FAILURE: share growth with no adverse compatible spread
candidate_value_or_range.WATCH: one adverse spread or one period

thresholds.economic_rationale: Share-count growth can fund value-creating investment; the risk is persistent negative per-share compounding, not issuance alone.
thresholds.historical_calibration_basis: Only one period-end-share T3 observation and five T0 weighted-average-share observations exist, so a hard maximum issuance rate is not defensible.
thresholds.evidence_requirement: Compatible T0/T1 share and numerator evidence; T3 is cross-check only.
thresholds.persistence_requirement: Two periods and two adverse compatible numerator spreads for persistent risk.
thresholds.recovery_condition: At least two compatible per-share spreads non-negative for two periods.
thresholds.hysteresis_rule: Persistent risk requires two recovery periods; one issuance period remains WATCH at most.

thresholds.formula: group-level level/trend synthesis without raw metric vote count
thresholds.economic_rationale: Receivables, inventory, supplier financing, cash conversion and capital intensity represent distinct economic mechanisms; correlated raw metrics must not be counted repeatedly.
thresholds.historical_calibration_basis: Remediated five-factor analytical model; Consignment percentage remains undisclosed and is not estimated.
thresholds.evidence_requirement: T0/T1 component evidence; T2 can support a directional WATCH only.
thresholds.persistence_requirement: Strong improving/deteriorating transition requires two periods.
thresholds.recovery_condition: Fewer than three deteriorating groups for two periods, with cash-conversion evidence available.
thresholds.hysteresis_rule: Level and trend remain separate; unavailable prior data cannot create deterioration.

thresholds.metric: P/E, P/B and P/S historical percentiles with ROIC, FCF and per-share support
thresholds.formula: multi-multiple descriptive position plus fundamental confirmation; no aggregate score

candidate_value_or_range.INCONCLUSIVE: fewer than 2 multiples or no post-event price

thresholds.economic_rationale: Historical percentile is descriptive; margin of safety requires valuation triangulation and economic-value/cash/per-share confirmation.
thresholds.historical_calibration_basis: P/E 21 periods median 11.08 range 8.58-16.92; P/B 21 periods median 1.07 range 0.95-1.82; P/S 18 periods median 0.24 range 0.21-0.41.
thresholds.evidence_requirement: T0/T1 price and denominators; T2 estimated P/S may support PARTIAL only; current policy requires POST_EVENT_PRICE.
thresholds.persistence_requirement: Candidate ATTRACTIVE/FULL requires one complete post-event observation; policy transition confirmation at next formal period.
thresholds.recovery_condition: At least two multiples return to 30th-70th percentile or fundamental supports improve.
thresholds.hysteresis_rule: One multiple cannot determine the state; pre-event data cannot activate current Add-on.

thresholds.formula: operating-profit quality, ROIC spread, FCF repair, per-share compounding, balance-sheet safety and competitive evidence

candidate_value_or_range.維持: no confirmed hard blocker and >=3 independent supports
candidate_value_or_range.REVIEW: one meaningful actual adverse factor or unresolved blocker
candidate_value_or_range.降級: >=2 corroborating actual adverse dimensions for >=2 periods including a hard-blocker category

thresholds.economic_rationale: A long-term holding thesis should change only on corroborated enterprise-value impairment, not a single weak estimate.
thresholds.historical_calibration_basis: Current Q2 evidence combines profit growth with negative cash conversion and incomplete same-basis ROIC/WACC evidence.
thresholds.evidence_requirement: Strong transition requires T0/T1 evidence across at least two independent dimensions; T2 supports REVIEW; T4 cannot trigger downgrade.
thresholds.persistence_requirement: Candidate downgrade requires two formal periods unless a direct thesis-invalidating event is confirmed.
thresholds.recovery_condition: Hard blocker resolved and >=3 independent supports confirmed for two periods.
thresholds.hysteresis_rule: Downgrade recovery requires stronger two-period evidence; one good quarter cannot restore 維持.
thresholds.missing_input_behavior: Missing WACC/current valuation or cash evidence -> REVIEW/PENDING, not automatic downgrade.

thresholds.formula: ROIC + FCF + WC + actual balance sheet + stress resilience + per-share + valuation support, subject to hard blockers

candidate_value_or_range.通過: >=6 of 7 supports, no hard blocker, POST_EVENT valuation
candidate_value_or_range.尚未通過: <=2 supports, any hard blocker, or no current valuation

thresholds.economic_rationale: Incremental capital assessment requires value creation, funding safety, per-share benefit and valuation margin together; FCF positivity is not a single hard rule.
thresholds.historical_calibration_basis: Current pre-event valuation and missing governed WACC/net-cash denominator prevent activation even though several analytical inputs exist.
thresholds.evidence_requirement: T0/T1 for hard blockers and current valuation; T2 may contribute partial support; T4 is stress context only.
thresholds.persistence_requirement: Candidate pass requires current complete inputs and confirmation at one formal event; structural supports use their own persistence rules.
thresholds.recovery_condition: All hard blockers cleared and at least six supports restored.
thresholds.hysteresis_rule: PARTIAL is analytical completeness only and never maps to partial position sizing.
thresholds.missing_input_behavior: Any mandatory current valuation/WACC/liquidity dependency -> 尚未通過/PENDING, no trading action.

thresholds.formula: actual adverse-factor count, hard-blocker confirmation and persistence; T4 excluded from triggering

candidate_value_or_range.WATCH: >=1 meaningful actual factor or unconfirmed T4 concern
candidate_value_or_range.TRIGGERED: confirmed hard blocker plus >=2 actual adverse dimensions for >=2 periods

thresholds.economic_rationale: WATCH is verified adverse evidence requiring follow-up; TRIGGERED requires materially stronger and persistent thesis impairment.
thresholds.historical_calibration_basis: Historical cash-flow reversals and incomplete current ROIC/WACC support a fast WATCH but a slower corroborated downgrade gate.
thresholds.evidence_requirement: T0/T1 actual evidence for TRIGGERED; T2 at most WATCH; T4 alone never triggers.
thresholds.persistence_requirement: Candidate WATCH may enter in one period; TRIGGERED requires two periods and two actual dimensions unless a direct invalidating event exists.
thresholds.recovery_condition: Hard blocker resolved plus two periods without corroborated impairment and with at least two positive supports.
thresholds.hysteresis_rule: TRIGGERED requires two recovery confirmations; WATCH may exit after one complete clean verification.
thresholds.missing_input_behavior: Missing corroboration -> WATCH or CANNOT_EVALUATE, never TRIGGERED.

thresholds.formula: apply only the threshold contract matching evaluation_type; preserve Evidence/Risk/Policy separation
thresholds.economic_rationale: A metric being available is not equivalent to a thesis being supported or a policy decision being authorized.
thresholds.historical_calibration_basis: Forward Model QA established typed SMART rows and INITIALIZED_BASELINE semantics.
thresholds.evidence_requirement: Evidence tier follows the underlying dimension; overrides require explicit reason and later Owner authority.
thresholds.persistence_requirement: Inherited from the underlying dimension; no independent SMART shortcut.
thresholds.hysteresis_rule: SMART cannot bypass underlying persistence or policy activation.
thresholds.missing_input_behavior: Return UNAVAILABLE/PENDING; never substitute zero or generic WATCH.
